info.background_text:
The last disciple of the Xiang Tribe.
A member of a small ethnic group called the Xiang that survived by living deep underground on Earth. Having lost all her kin to Earth’s Chaos, Mei Lin strives to uphold one of the Xiang tribe’s teachings of “loving everyone.”
